entries.source_quote: A device replacement is allowed only when the newest warranty observation for the identical case reports active coverage. An older positive observation does not beat a newer negative one.
canonical_bullets: Before **replacing** any **device**, check that the **warranty observation** is **active** for the **SAME case**.
Use the latest **warranty-observation** check result for that **case**. An earlier **active** result cannot override a later **inactive** result.

entries.source_quote: Before replacing the device, obtain a supervisor's approval for that same case. A warranty check is not supervisor approval.
canonical_bullets: Before **replacing** any **device**, check that the **supervisor approval** is **granted** for the **SAME case**.

entries.source_quote: Logging a service audit requires an earlier successful device replacement for that very case.
canonical_bullets: After a **device** has been **replaced** successfully, record a **service** audit for the **SAME case**. Do not record the audit before successful **replacement**.
